reported.quote: our consolidated revenue grew by a strong 18% YoY, driven primarily by robust performance in our Wires & Cables business
This translated into a ~430 bps YoY and ~130 bps QoQ improvement in EBITDA margin, which stood at 15.8%.
At the PAT level, the Company delivered its highest ever second quarter PAT at ~₹ 7.0 billion, reflecting 56% YoY growth.
We continue to maintain a strong balance sheet, closing the quarter with a net cash position of ₹ 29.4 billion.
The Wires & Cables business delivered a 21% YoY revenue growth, supported by high-teen volume expansion during the quarter.
